name: CanUseVehicle
description: Check whether an actor can begin a fresh ride now.
note: Does not reserve the vehicle or approve takeovers, theft confirmation or route availability. A later action can still fail.
example:
if MyCarRef.CanUseVehicle Player
    DrvMount MyCarRef
endif

name: DrvAddDriver
description: Spawn a driver at the calling vehicle and start a wandering ride.
note: Call on the vehicle. The optional argument is an actor base, not an existing actor. If omitted, the traffic driver pool is used.

name: DrvDamageVehicle
description: Apply damage to a vehicle.
note: Pass a vehicle reference explicitly, or call on the vehicle / select it in the console. Omitting the argument does not automatically select your current ride. Amount is raw health damage, not a percentage.

name: DrvDismount
description: Request that the player dismount.

name: DrvEndRace
description: Queue the end of the current race.

name: DrvGetActiveHorse
description: Get the selected stable horse.

name: DrvGetActorVehicle
description: Find an actor’s current vehicle or horse, including passengers.

name: DrvGetEncounterAlive
description: Count surviving members of a configured encounter.

name: DrvGetFuel
description: Read the stored fuel reserve.
returns: Stored reserve in litres, or -1 for an invalid vehicle.
note: Pass a vehicle reference explicitly, or call on the vehicle / select it in the console. Omitting the argument does not automatically select your current ride. Use DrvGetFuelCapacity to check whether the vehicle has a supported fuel system.

name: DrvGetFuelCapacity
description: Read the capacity of a supported fuel system.
returns: Capacity in litres, or -1 if unsupported.

name: DrvGetHorseBond
description: Read the horse’s bond.

name: DrvGetHorseCommand
description: Read the horse’s current command.
returns: 0 free, 1 follow, 2 wait, or -1 if invalid.

name: DrvGetHorseStamina
description: Read the horse’s current stamina.
note: Includes resting recovery. A profile with stamina disabled returns 100.

name: DrvGetHorseTrait
description: Read one of the horse’s individual ratings.
note: Trait: 0 speed, 1 endurance, 2 nerve. Ratings are not physics multipliers.

name: DrvGetPassenger
description: Get the passenger assigned to a seat.
note: Passenger seats start at 1. Query the driver separately.

name: DrvGetPassengerCount
description: Count passengers assigned to this vehicle.
note: Passenger support concerns the player’s vehicle.

name: DrvGetPlayerVehicle
description: Get the player’s current vehicle.

name: DrvGetRideDriver
description: Read the driver assigned to an NPC ride.
note: For a query that also covers the player, use vehicle.DrvGetVehicleDriver.

name: DrvGetRideState
description: Read the NPC ride state.
returns: 0 none, 1 pending, 2 route, 3 wander, 4 destination, 5 chasing.

name: DrvGetRideTarget
description: Read an NPC ride’s chase target.

name: DrvGetVehicleCondition
description: Read rounded vehicle health as a percentage.
note: Use DrvGetVehicleHealth for raw health points.

name: DrvGetVehicleDriver
description: Get a vehicle’s active player or NPC driver.
note: Pending NPC rides do not count as active drivers.

name: DrvGetVehicleHealth
description: Read raw vehicle health.
note: Pass a vehicle reference explicitly, or call on the vehicle / select it in the console. Omitting the argument does not automatically select your current ride. Use DrvGetVehicleCondition for a percentage.

name: DrvGetVehicleSpeed
description: Read horizontal speed, including reverse and sideways motion.
returns: Speed in metres per second, or -1 if unavailable.
note: Loaded parked vehicles return 0. Unloaded vehicles and untracked bumped hulls return -1. Multiply by 3.6 for km/h or 2.23694 for mph.

name: DrvGetVehicleType
description: Read the vehicle category.
returns: 0 invalid, 1 road, 2 motorcycle, 3 human-powered, 4 hover, 5 aircraft, 6 boat, 7 horse or living mount.

name: DrvGetVehicleUseFailure
description: Explain why an actor cannot begin a fresh ride.
returns: 0 if allowed, otherwise a failure code from the table below.
note: Uses the same eligibility check as CanUseVehicle.

name: DrvHasVehicleFault
description: Check whether a vehicle has a recorded fault.
note: Pass a vehicle reference explicitly, or call on the vehicle / select it in the console. Omitting the argument does not automatically select your current ride.

name: DrvHorseCrap
description: Request the horse’s manure action.
note: Choose a calm, stationary horse. Pass the horse, select it in the console, or omit the target while riding a horse.

name: DrvMount
description: Request mounting the player on a vehicle.
returns: 1 if the transition was requested, 0 otherwise.
note: Pass a vehicle reference explicitly, or call on the vehicle / select it in the console. Omitting the argument does not automatically select your current ride. This starts an action. It does not mean the transition has finished.

name: DrvPlaceRamp
description: Place a static ramp ahead of the player, aligned with their facing.
note: Requires a STAT base. Placement uses terrain height where available. Check clearance yourself.

name: DrvPopTyre
description: Mark a tyre as punctured.
note: Pass a vehicle reference explicitly, or call on the vehicle / select it in the console. Omitting the argument does not automatically select your current ride. Use indices 0–5 for wheel slots. -1 punctures all slots. The vehicle must have an appropriate tyre rig for the expected visual result.

name: DrvRecoverVehicle
description: Request recovery of a vehicle.
note: Pass a vehicle reference explicitly, or call on the vehicle / select it in the console. Omitting the argument does not automatically select your current ride. Recovery can be refused by the vehicle’s current state or race restrictions.

name: DrvRefuel
description: Fill a vehicle’s configured fuel reserve.
note: Pass a vehicle reference explicitly, or call on the vehicle / select it in the console. Omitting the argument does not automatically select your current ride. This directly fills the reserve without consuming inventory supplies. Active race service restrictions still apply.

name: DrvRepairVehicle
description: Restore vehicle health and supported damaged parts.
note: Pass a vehicle reference explicitly, or call on the vehicle / select it in the console. Omitting the argument does not automatically select your current ride. This is a direct repair. It does not consume repair tools or apply the menu’s skill check. Active race service restrictions still apply.

name: DrvRestoreVehicle
description: Attempt the configured restoration using the player’s skill and inventory.
note: Pass a vehicle reference explicitly, or call on the vehicle / select it in the console. Omitting the argument does not automatically select your current ride. Requires the vehicle to be loaded, nearby, unlocked and unoccupied. On success the required item is consumed. This is separate from DrvRepairVehicle.

name: DrvSetFuel
description: Set the stored fuel reserve.
note: Pass a vehicle reference explicitly, or call on the vehicle / select it in the console. Omitting the argument does not automatically select your current ride. The value is litres, clamped to the vehicle’s capacity. No inventory supply is consumed.

name: DrvSetHorseBond
description: Set a stabled horse’s bond for testing.
note: Development console only. Requires a living, enabled, registered horse and a finite percentage from 0 to 100.

name: DrvSetHorseCommand
description: Give a living stabled horse a command.
note: 0 free, 1 follow, 2 wait. Asking a new horse to follow moves the previous follower to wait.

name: DrvSetHorseName
description: Rename a living player-owned stabled horse.
note: Accepts a string literal or string variable. Names are trimmed and limited to 31 allowed characters. An empty string restores the base name.

name: DrvSetHorseTack
description: Show or hide a horse’s tack.
note: Use 0 to hide or 1 to show. Pass a horse reference or call on the horse.

name: DrvSetRideAggression
description: Change the aggression value of an active NPC ride.
note: Requires an active NPC driving session. The ride request default is 1.0.

name: DrvSetRideSpeed
description: Change the cruise speed of an active NPC ride.
note: Speed is metres per second. Requires an active NPC driving session.

name: DrvSetVehicleFault
description: Set a fault message which prevents normal use.
note: Pass a vehicle reference explicitly, or call on the vehicle / select it in the console. Omitting the argument does not automatically select your current ride. An empty string clears the fault.
example: DrvSetVehicleFault "The engine needs a replacement part." MyCarRef

name: DrvSetVehicleLocked
description: Set the plugin’s vehicle lock.
note: Pass a vehicle reference explicitly, or call on the vehicle / select it in the console. Omitting the argument does not automatically select your current ride. Use 0 to unlock, 1 to lock.

name: DrvSetVehicleRestoration
description: Assign a restoration component and Repair requirement.
note: Pass a vehicle reference explicitly, or call on the vehicle / select it in the console. Omitting the argument does not automatically select your current ride. The component must be a MISC form. Repair skill must be between 0 and 100. Set a fault separately. This defines the requirement, it does not perform a repair.

name: DrvSpawnVehicle
description: Spawn a registered vehicle base.
note: Pass a base form, not a placed reference. The optional placement reference supplies position and heading. It falls back to the caller, then the player. Use an anchor in the player’s current world or cell. Arena unlock restrictions still apply.

name: DrvStartChase
description: Ask an NPC driver to pursue a target reference.
note: The target may be a vehicle or actor.

name: DrvStartEncounter
description: Start a configured vehicle encounter.
note: The quest must belong to a configured encounter.

name: DrvStartRace
description: Queue race setup with optional vehicle assignments.
note: Omitted options use defaults. The opponent argument is a FormList of supported vehicle bases, up to 16 entries. This queues setup rather than confirming the race has begun.

name: DrvStartRide
description: Start an NPC following a route, or wandering if the route is omitted.
note: Route paths are Data-relative. Acceptance may queue a ride while its model loads.

name: DrvStartRideTo
description: Send an NPC in a vehicle to a destination reference.
note: Use a placed destination reference. A successful request is not proof of arrival.

name: DrvStopRide
description: Stop an NPC ride.
note: retain motion: 0 stops the ride without retaining motion, 1 requests retaining motion.

name: IsDrivable
description: Check whether a reference is a recognised vehicle or horse.

name: IsDriving
description: Check whether an actor is driving.
note: Covers non-living vehicles, including stationary active driving sessions. IsRiding is the living-mount query.
example:
if Player.IsDriving
    let vehicle := DrvGetPlayerVehicle
endif

name: IsEngineRunning
description: Check whether a motorised engine is running.
note: Horses and human-powered rides return 0.

name: IsHorsePanicking
description: Check for active panic or a panic rear.
note: An unmounted horse returns 0.

name: IsInVehicle
description: Check whether an actor is aboard a specific vehicle.
returns: 1 if driver or passenger of that vehicle, otherwise 0.
example:
if Player.IsInVehicle MyCarRef
    let condition := MyCarRef.DrvGetVehicleCondition
endif

name: IsPassenger
description: Check whether an actor is assigned as a passenger.
note: Reports logical seat assignment, including temporary save suspension.

name: IsRiding
description: Check whether an actor is riding a horse or another living mount.
note: This is the living-mount query. IsDriving covers non-living vehicles. Use IsPassenger for passenger assignment.

name: IsStabled
description: Check whether a horse is registered in the stable.

name: IsVehicleLocked
description: Read the plugin’s vehicle lock.

name: IsVehicleOccupied
description: Check for an active driver or assigned passenger.

name: IsVehicleWrecked
description: Check for a destroyed hull or dead vehicle / mount.
